payload.message: Frozen TAT-QA scorer tuple values were serialized to JSON arrays, so durable rows differed from in-memory rows at publication.

remediation.description: Normalize frozen scorer output to strict JSON-native evidence before raw row hash/publication.

payload.message: Day20 v3 wrapper passed two arguments to frozen Day10 load_humaneval_source(config), causing TypeError before any sandbox execution.

remediation.description: Call frozen Day10 load_humaneval_source(config) with its exact signature, materialize the exact frozen source at its repository-relative path, and separate prefixed frozen semantic hash from raw v3 comparison hash.
